15: 	}

23: func (r *loggingResponseWriter) Write(b []byte) (int, error) {
24: 	size, err := r.ResponseWriter.Write(b)
25: 	r.responseData.size += size
26: 	return size, err
27: }
28: 
29: func (r *loggingResponseWriter) WriteHeader(statusCode int) {
30: 	r.ResponseWriter.WriteHeader(statusCode)
31: 	r.responseData.status = statusCode
32: }

34: func RequestLogger(h http.HandlerFunc) http.HandlerFunc {
35: 	logFn := http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
36: 		start := time.Now()
37: 
38: 		responseData := &responseData{
39: 			status: 0,
40: 			size:   0,
41: 		}
42: 		lw := loggingResponseWriter{
43: 			ResponseWriter: w,
44: 			responseData:   responseData,
45: 		}
46: 
47: 		h.ServeHTTP(&lw, r)
48: 		duration := time.Since(start)
49: 		logger.Log.Info("got incoming HTTP request",
50: 			zap.String("method", r.Method),
51: 			zap.String("uri", r.URL.Path),
52: 			zap.String("duration", duration.String()),
53: 		)
54: 		logger.Log.Info("got outgoing HTTP response",
55: 			zap.Int("status", responseData.status),
56: 			zap.Int("size", responseData.size),
57: 		)
58: 	})
59: 	return http.HandlerFunc(logFn)
60: }

10: func GzipCompressor(h http.HandlerFunc) http.HandlerFunc {
11: 	return func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
12: 		ow := w
13: 		acceptEncoding := r.Header.Get("Accept-Encoding")
14: 		supportsGzip := strings.Contains(acceptEncoding, "gzip")
15: 		if supportsGzip {
16: 			cw := compress.NewGzipWriter(w)
17: 			ow = cw
18: 			defer cw.Close()
19: 		}
20: 
21: 		contentEncoding := r.Header.Get("Content-Encoding")
22: 		sendsGzip := strings.Contains(contentEncoding, "gzip")
23: 		if sendsGzip {
24: 			cr, err := compress.NewGzipReader(r.Body)
25: 			if err != nil {
26: 				w.WriteHeader(http.StatusInternalServerError)
27: 				return
28: 			}
29: 			r.Body = cr
30: 			defer cr.Close()
31: 		}
32: 		h.ServeHTTP(ow, r)
33: 	}
34: }
